C.name: Predictive Coding（預測編碼）
C.responsibility: Prediction, observation, prediction-error measurement, uncertainty calibration and evidence-based model updates.

E.name: Deep Research（深度研究）
E.responsibility: Multi-source research, source provenance and quality, corroboration, counter-evidence, cited synthesis and cross-track research support.

F.name: Cyber Security & Defense
F.responsibility: Cross-track threat modeling, minimum security controls, adversarial validation, vulnerability response and incident readiness.

G.name: Release, QA & Integration
G.responsibility: Integration sequencing, compatibility matrices, regression suites, release gates and exact-SHA evidence.

H.name: Observability, Telemetry & Cost/Quota Governance
H.responsibility: Queue and Runner telemetry, task timing, failure taxonomy, cost accounting and quota alerts.

I.name: Ecosystem, Connectors & Workflow Automation
I.responsibility: External APIs, webhooks, notifications, synchronization and event adapters with least-privilege boundaries.

J.name: Self-Healing, Chaos & Continuity
J.responsibility: Bounded recovery, circuit breakers, checkpointing, backup and restore verification, and controlled fault drills.

K.name: Knowledge Base, Docs & Governance Playbooks
K.responsibility: Architecture records, runbooks, handoff templates, decision logs and operator playbooks.

L.name: Multi-Node, Federation & Edge/Cluster Coordination
L.responsibility: Capability-aware node registration, scheduling, leases, health and cross-node coordination, gated by demonstrated need.

M.name: Compliance, Policy Audit & Risk Governance
M.responsibility: Evidence retention, change and audit trails, policy checks, exception ownership and risk register.

N.name: Productization, Analytics & Growth/Ecosystem Ops
N.responsibility: Product outcomes, adoption and quality metrics, feedback loops, onboarding and ecosystem operations.

O.name: Lifecycle, Deprecation & Legacy Retirement
O.responsibility: Deprecation policy, migration windows, compatibility and controlled removal of obsolete components.

P.name: Governance, Ethics & Trust/Policy Evolution
P.responsibility: Cross-track autonomy boundaries, human-approval thresholds, trust principles and governance arbitration.

policy: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; every change increments at least PATCH; breaking architecture increments MAJOR; additive capability increments MINOR. Cross-track changes require explicit owner review and compatibility evidence.
